senses.gloss: m. (צָבַע II) dyeing material, plant used for dyeing.—Pl. צוֹבְעִים, צוֹבְעִין.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 7:1">Shebi. VII, 1</cite>, sq. <he>ממין הצ׳</he> (Ar. <he>הצבעין</he>) plants belonging to the class of dyers. Y. ib. VII, beg. 37ᵇ <he>צב׳ לאדם</he> dyeing plants to be used by men; <he>צב׳ לבהמה</he> to be used for food of beasts, in the Sabbatical year; a. e.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:1:5">Y. Sabb. VI, 7ᵈ</cite> <he>צ׳ תותבן</he>, v. <cite ref="R00064"><he>צִבְעוֹן</he> II</cite>.]
